about: Zetwerk is a technology-led, asset-light manufacturing platform that aggregates capacity from 6,979 third-party suppliers in 26 countries plus 26 own facilities, run on its proprietary Zetwerk OS. It has two segments: Manufacturing (Energy, Precision and Capital Goods products; 58.9% of FY26 revenue) and Ecosystem/Terra91 (commodity trading). It exited its Civil Infrastructure Works segment in FY26 (shown as discontinued).
sector: Manufacturing platform / industrial and consumer goods

objects.purpose: Repayment/prepayment of borrowings of the Company
Repayment/prepayment of borrowings of certain subsidiaries via investment in them
Unidentified inorganic acquisitions and general corporate purposes (capped at 35% of gross proceeds)

promoters.background: Both founders are IIT Madras alumni who began their careers at ITC; promoter group holds a further 4.80%. About 28.46 million promoter shares were previously pledged to a security trustee under promoter borrowing arrangements.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 35.90% of FY26 revenue (26.89% FY25, 22.37% FY24). Top 10 suppliers were 38.18% of FY26 expenses. India 82.54% and USA 14.33% of FY26 revenue.

litigation_note: Material litigation per RHP: 66 criminal proceedings by the Company (Rs 620.14 crore involved) and 1 material civil case by it; against the Company 5 criminal, 30 tax, 12 regulatory and 1 civil matter (about Rs 22.97 crore). Contingent liabilities at Jun-26: corporate guarantees Rs 379.29 crore, bank guarantees Rs 650.20 crore, excise Rs 46.11 crore, GST Rs 58.71 crore.
strengths: Manufacturing order book of Rs 12,370 crore at Mar-26 (Rs 13,062 crore at Jun-26) gives good revenue visibility, with new orders of Rs 15,393 crore in FY26.
FY26 revenue rose 40.4% to Rs 15,913 crore, driven by Manufacturing segment revenue growing 50% to Rs 9,375 crore.
Asset-light hybrid model: 6,979 suppliers in 26 countries plus 26 own facilities, coordinated through proprietary Zetwerk OS.
Repeat customers contributed 80.15% of Manufacturing revenue in FY26; 906 active Manufacturing customers including 102 of India's Fortune 500.
Adjusted EBITDA grew from Rs 97 crore in FY24 to Rs 421 crore in FY26; Manufacturing EBITDA margin was 6.03% in FY26.
Gross margin improved from 7.66% in FY24 to 12.13% in FY26 as own manufacturing and ODM share (13.93% of GMV) increased.
Manufacturing business ROCE of 22.75% in FY26 and 30.76% in FY25 (segment level, per RHP).
About Rs 2,160 crore of fresh issue proceeds are earmarked to repay borrowings, which should reduce interest cost.

risks.title: Persistent losses
risks.detail: Loss from continuing operations of Rs 964 crore in FY26, Rs 215 crore in FY25 and Rs 853 crore in FY24; including discontinued operations FY26 loss was Rs 1,606 crore. Basic EPS was -6.69 in FY26 and RoNW -21.11%.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow
risks.detail: Net cash used in operations was Rs 682 crore in FY26, Rs 386 crore in FY25 and Rs 282 crore in FY24, and also negative in both Q1 periods (Rs 506 crore in Q1 FY27). Growth is consuming cash.

risks.title: High debt and working capital needs
risks.detail: Total borrowings including non-fund-based facilities were Rs 5,208 crore at Aug-31-2026. Business needs significant working capital; only about 64% of fund-based borrowings are to be repaid from the issue.

risks.title: Offer for sale and valuation
risks.detail: The OFS of 144.5 million shares goes to selling shareholders, not the company; only Rs 2,830 crore is fresh. No listed peer exists for comparison, and the company has issued shares at Rs 171 per share in the last 12 months.

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers contributed 35.90% of FY26 revenue, up from 22.37% in FY24, and many orders are short-term purchase orders without firm long-term commitments.

risks.title: Supplier dependence and Ecosystem low margin
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers were 38.18% of FY26 expenses. The commodity-trading Ecosystem segment is 41% of FY26 segment revenue at only a 1.24% EBITDA margin.

risks.title: Large share-based payments and related-party items
risks.detail: Related-party share-based payments and fair-value dilution items to key management were Rs 572 crore in FY26 (64.72% of the relevant denominator); promoters had pledged 28.46 million shares; auditors included emphasis of matter paragraphs.

risks.title: Litigation and contingent liabilities
risks.detail: Against the Company: 5 criminal, 30 tax, 12 regulatory proceedings; contingent liabilities at Jun-26 include corporate guarantees of Rs 379 crore and bank guarantees of Rs 650 crore given for joint ventures and associates.

notes: RHP: price band, issue price, OFS value, post-issue shares, P/E left null. Restated consolidated, Rs million converted to Rs crore. Q1 FY27 stub ignored in arrays (Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 4,118 crore, loss from continuing ops Rs 64 crore). pbt/pat/margin are continuing operations (revenue is also continuing); FY26 total loss incl. discontinued is Rs 1,606 crore (FY25 Rs 371 crore, FY24 Rs 918 crore). ebitda is company-reported Adjusted EBITDA (adds back share-based payments), not conventional EBITDA. net_worth is equity attributable to owners (RoNW denominators differ slightly). reserves is other equity (Mar-26 negative; CCPS instrument equity of Rs 4,658 crore reported separately). borrowings = current plus non-current borrowings from the balance sheet; cash_and_bank = cash plus other bank balances. current_ratio computed from balance sheet totals. EPS are continuing-ops and adjusted for bonus/capital reduction. ROCE, ROE, debt/equity not reported at company level.
